subject: Zenovia — request for goodwill service credit and trial extension
messages:
From: Tara Li <tara.li@zenovia.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, ethan.ward@zenovia.com
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 16:13:00 -0500
Subject: Production latency spikes impacting checkout — request for credits and trial extension

Hi Hannah,

We saw repeated latency spikes across multiple regions on 2026-12-19 between 14:00-17:30 UTC that affected our checkout and recommendation flows. Our SREs have attached a short timeline and a few example traces. The impact led to ~8% dropped requests and several customer complaints.

We value Redwood and want to keep ramping usage, but given the impact were requesting a goodwill token/top-up to cover the remainder of our pilots and a 30-day extension of our trial period while our team validates the fix. Can you advise what you can offer and next steps for approval?

Attachments: [incident-timeline-zenovia-20261220.pdf (pdf), example-traces-zenovia.txt (txt)]

Thanks,
Tara Li
Head of Platform, Zenovia
From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
To: Tara Li <tara.li@zenovia.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 17:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Production latency spikes impacting checkout — request for credits and trial extension

Tara —

Thank you for the timeline and the traces. Im really sorry this disrupted your pilot. Aditya and I reviewed the logs; we see the inference queue rebuilt several times due to a kernel scheduling regression after a model variant rollout. Engineering has reverted the rollout and applied a hotfix overnight — were monitoring for recurrence.

I want to move quickly on a goodwill offer while we stabilize. Proposed immediate offer (pending final approvals from Finance/RevOps):
- 100k free generation token top-up (applied as account credit)
- 30-day trial extension on your dedicated pilot seat
- Post-mortem summary from our SREs by end of week

If that seems reasonable Ill escalate for signoff. Im copying Marissa to coordinate CS acceptance language and Stephanie to confirm billing/contract changes.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
From: aditya_rao@redwood.com
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 21 Dec 2026 09:08:00 -0500
Subject: internal: Zenovia goodwill credit proposal + approval request

Hannah/Marissa —

Quick summary for approvals:
- Root cause: kernel scheduling regression tied to LLM runtime variant deployment; rollback applied 2026-12-20 01:10 UTC
- Impact window: ~3.5 hours; ~8% request failures during that window (Zenovia traces attached in customer thread)
- Proposed account actions: 100k token top-up + 30-day trial extension + waived one month of overage (if any) during the impacted billing cycle

Finance/RevOps guidance: we can cover the token top-up under the goodwill bucket for customer retention; anything beyond 150k tokens will need Director approval from Stephanie.

Attachments: [proposed-credit-sheet-zenovia-20261221.xlsx]

Aditya
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 21 Dec 2026 14:41:00 -0500
Subject: Re: internal: Zenovia goodwill credit proposal + approval request

Thanks for the context. Approve as proposed: 100,000 tokens + 30-day trial extension + waive any overage charges tied specifically to the 2026-12-19 incident.

Execution notes:
- Finance will issue a service credit to the account (account note + ledger entry) after CS confirms acceptance language.
- For contract amendment: use the standard amendment form and route via DocuSign (link below).

Please confirm with the customer and send the amendment for signature.

Stephanie Nguyen
Revenue Operations Manager, Redwood Inference

Related link: https://redwood-docusign.com/ENVELOPEID/abc123
From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
To: Tara Li <tara.li@zenovia.com>, Ethan Ward <ethan.ward@zenovia.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 22 Dec 2026 11:04:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Production latency spikes impacting checkout — request for credits and trial extension

Tara/Ethan —

Thanks again for raising this and for the traces — that made root cause analysis much faster. Weve approved the following and can apply them immediately upon your confirmation:
- 100,000 token credit applied to your account (visible in billing dashboard)
- 30-day extension to your pilot trial window
- Waiver of any overage charges directly attributable to the 2026-12-19 incident

Ive attached a short amendment that documents the top-up and trial extension; signing via DocuSign will finalize it and trigger the ledger entry. Post-mortem and engineering RCA are in progress; ETA EOD Friday.

Attachments: [signed-amendment-zenovia-docusign.pdf (will be generated after signature)]

Please reply here to accept and Ill send the DocuSign envelope.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
